policy.scope: current manuscript prose, equations, referenced TeX display fragments, and referenced final display assets
policy.excluded: research code, data, fitted objects, caches, simulations, complete output archives, and source histories
policy.rights: UNVERIFIED; private-source access and technical integration do not establish permission to publish
policy.source_worktrees: original research working trees were not fetched, checked out, built, or modified

editorial_resolutions: Replaced the unresolved PriceFM abstract placeholder with the matched 114-comparison result already reported by the current Q--DESN article.
Treated the current RQR article as authority for the profiled MTI tolerance procedure and retained the unchanged extension article only for conditional regression and dynamic models.
Preserved current main texts in Chapters 4 and 5 and placed current supplements in Appendices D and E.
Updated Chapter 2 to the exdqlm 1.1.2 rerun and copied its nine current manuscript figures.
